fixtures.R: One owned, available, confirmed blue dress with valid current owner-reviewed casual singleton style; no occasion/formality declarations; absent unrelated appearance evidence.
fixtures.R_smart: R with valid reviewed smart casual instead.
fixtures.A: Complete owned available confirmed dress with clean exact occasion Allow, absent style review.
fixtures.X: R with exact occasion Allow and Deny.
fixtures.M: R with malformed authoritative occasion data and no identifiable Deny.
fixtures.C: R with current reviewed classic style.
fixtures.R_red: R with known primary red and no blue in any member.
fixtures.R_stale: R whose style review no longer binds current category/value.
fixtures.R_outer_unknown: R plus otherwise eligible outerwear missing required style/occasion evidence; base-only dress remains valid.
fixtures.empty: No eligible snapshots (parameterise actual owner/status/confirmation exclusions).
fixtures.only_upper: One qualifying upper member, no lower/dress.
fixtures.occasion_allow_formality_deny: Complete dress with exact occasion Allow and requested formality Deny.
fixtures.R_unrequested_formality_deny: R with formality smart_casual Deny but no requested formality.
fixtures.legacy_formality_allow: Complete eligible dress with exact legacy casual formality Allow.

invariants.assertion: All four structures: enumerate all eligible candidates and compare exact Fraction component/total scores, ties and winners against independent reference.
Foreign, archived, unavailable, unconfirmed and mismatched processing-owner rows never enter the ranking snapshot.
Review or availability changed between ranking and locked commit yields WardrobeChanged with zero partial writes.
Identical key/text replay returns original snapshots/provenance/scores after profile change and actual process restart; changed text conflicts.
Current legacy/wedding/general accepted labels remain frozen; versioned new labels record intentional everyday command-path transitions separately.
100 non-archived-entry quota, saved preferences, Homepage no-chat selection and durable copied-token logout remain unchanged.
At 100 current snapshots, evidence/compilation work is bounded outside candidate iteration; no DB/model/network calls in the hot loop.
Missing unrelated appearance observations cannot change an everyday result; requested-code or style review Unknown can.
Reject forged frame/bundle/condition proofs, unknown operators, over-depth/size configuration and missing registry references.
Adding temporal/companions metadata without changing mandatory facts adds no score term; changing saved preferences uses existing snapshot/P semantics only.

browser_acceptance.assertion: Real register/login on disposable DB; class/shopping/friends requests through ordinary production component and API proxy.
Review a truthful reusable style once; reuse across the three bindings without occasion grids; Cancel/failure preserve draft/storage.
Missing or uncovered review: correct field guidance, no prompt to relabel classic; explicit Deny retains controlled no-result.
Missing interview role/code, inactive graduation/hiking and unsupported modifiers show distinct explanations; no generic auto-resubmission.
History search/open/replay, Save as outfit and VIS source eligibility retain exact names/scores/proofs without real inference.
360/390/768/1280/1920 widths, valid 100-character name, Tab/Enter and browser-native 200% for added explanations.
Existing wedding/date/dinner/presentation/interview and durable logout smoke journeys remain correct; production build pins final sources.
No manual services/private accounts involved; actual browser product/version recorded, no bundled Chromium substitution for a product claim.
